notes.title: 无限连战、更多主角配饰，现已上线
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, I'm the developer. "Dawn Dew" has been online for over a month. Thank you all for your support!ːluvː[/p][p][/p][h3]Since its release, from bug fixes to game optimization, it has undergone more than 50 patch updates. And today, [b]I bring you a free content update[/b]ːluvː[/h3][p][/p][p]The following is a brief summary of the content update:[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44780535/a71a8971fc03b962d11b7d8765d0def980fdd112.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Infinite Battle:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Infinite Battle is now available. Reach further waves in Infinite Battle! [/p][/*][*][p]The strength of the enemies will increase with each wave, and it is not affected by the number of playthroughs or game difficulty. [/p][/*][*][p]Choose the number of waves you want to challenge and start the challenge (you can quit halfway and save your progress). [/p][/*][*][p]In the infinite battle mode, some enemies that do not have attack power multipliers will have an additional damage reduction balance mechanism; some enemies that restore a certain percentage of their health will have a balance mechanism after a certain number of waves. [/p][/*][*][p]Failure or retreat will not reset the battle wave, but only accumulate the number of challenges.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Main character Dress up:[/h3][list][*][p]Hairstyle - Eternal Guardianship (After completing the task "Reward of Ruins' Tears", talk to "Beneficiary of Morning Dew" to purchase)[/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44780535/0920ee2608ee7d33db555e3cdfa6d7ac7702bfc0.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Face Makeup - Eye Light Yarn (After completing the quest "Reward of the Ruins", talk to "Beneficiary of the Morning Dew" to purchase)[/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44780535/42e180d5950d00a3076786eeb082c99e2f7f5c64.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Shoe - Flower's Footprints (Collected near the "Tranquil Place of the Heart" in the "Gap Between Worlds")[/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44780535/8b4569be249ec7f0590ff5cb457d10a9825f2a9e.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Headwear - Otherworld Authority (Cat Ears) (Purchase from the "Carver" located at "Path of Mercy")[/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44780535/d3dda4cb84f768432a97731b07280cf800ccc919.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Headwear - Realm‘s Crown (Located on the platform to the right that unlocks after purging the Collector's residual malice) [/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44780535/17a4e56d9a2ce85a93020edb4c62213b5529b892.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Balance adjustment:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]In the unique effect "Insanity", a new effect has been added: Each layer of "Flow" on oneself reduces this damage by 15%. [/p][/*][*][p]At the beginning of each turn: Deal 200% of your attack power damage to yourself and adjacent units, and apply 2 layers of "Resistance Reduction". [/p][/*][*][p]Reduce the defense value of the enemy "Small Clump of Flesh"; [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Game Optimization:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Now, the engraver will grant rewards based on the cumulative number of crafted items, preventing players from being unable to claim the cumulative crafting rewards in multiple playthroughs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]If you encounter any difficult problems in the game, please check this announcement! ↓↓[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2678640/announcements/detail/515218419125059808"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p]Finally, thank you for your visit! You are also welcome to join the QQ group or Discord to communicate together~[/p][p]QQ：1016713780 [url="https://qm.qq.com/q/zmEl0irHfG"]https://qm.qq.com/q/zmEl0irHfG[/url][/p][p]Discord：[url="https://discord.gg/xEEA6HaS"]https://discord.gg/xEEA6HaS[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix V1.070 Patch Note
notes.content:
[p]大家好，我是开发者葱色兔兔~，接下来为大家通报今天的更新修复内容：[/p][p][/p][p][b]Game optimization:[/b][/p][list][*][p]After entering the multi weekly session, the experience rewards in the book can be claimed again;[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize game performance during battles;[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize several terrain details to make characters move better;[/p][/*][*][p]The Boss death animation in BossRush is no longer played slowly;[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/p][h3][b]To address the issue of abnormal upward input without using a controller: Add a "disable controller" option in the settings interface/graphic settings. If there is no such bug, there is no need to check it;[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.cdn.queniuqe.com/images//44780535/354e0a50b0cdf0057223189ee4dc260d7508cfd0.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p][b]Balance adjustment:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enemy value adjustment:[/p][/*][*][p]The upper limit of enemy level has been changed from 200 to 999; (New changes added)[/p][/*][*][p]The enemy's defensive value will no longer increase with level after reaching level 100; (New changes added)[/p][/*][*][p]The enemy's defense will no longer increase with level after level 200; (New changes added)[/p][/*][*][p]The enemy's attack power does not increase with level after reaching level 100; (Originally existing)[/p][/*][*][p]The enemy's understanding does not increase with level after level 100; (Originally existing)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The above numerical changes have little impact on the main process, as there are no enemies exceeding level 100 in one playthrough, and in multi playthrough, the difficulty limit for five playthrough is also around level 200 for enemies.[/b] The main purpose of this enemy numerical adjustment is to prepare for the upcoming unlimited battles.[/p][list][*][p]The defensive value (resilience bar) of the enemy's crazy and filthy flag decreases;[/p][/*][*][p]Enhance the skill of 'Bloodstained Return' to shake the prison posture: the damage value increases from 8% ->10%;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]In addition, if there are any difficult issues with the game, please refer to this announcement~!↓↓↓[/b][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2678640/partnerevents/preview/515218419125059807"]https://steamcommunity.com/games/2678640/partnerevents/preview/515218419125059807[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Subsequent schedule:[/b][/h3][p][b]Infinite BossRush and more protagonist accessories will be updated for free before September 30th~[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Finally, welcome to click on the group link below ↓↓↓, join the group and communicate together~![/p]

notes.title: Summary of updated content/follow-up game schedule
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone~ːluvː[/p][h3]Dawn Dew has been on sale for two weeks now. Thank you for your support~~ Today the discount ends, and Dawn Dew will enter a short period of maintenance.[/h3][p][i]However, the next discount won't be far away; it is expected to be on sale again in the late September! [/i][/p][hr][/hr][p]Next, let's first present to you a summary of the recent updates: 

[b]New archive backup function added:[/b]   [/p][list][*][p]When the game is saved now, an additional backup archive will be automatically created (e.g., JORArchiveData0Backup.dat).  The game will not detect this save file. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]If you want to use this save file, delete "Backup" from the name of the backup save file, and the game will be able to read this save file.[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Game Optimization:[/b]  [/p][list][*][p]Those who missed out on the "Law - Coalescent Birth" during the event can purchase it from the White Tide located at the far left of the gap between the realms at the end of the story.[/p][/*][*][p]The operation for the protagonist to change accessories has become more convenient.   [/p][/*][*][p]The shops in the residence lounge now have a new text prompt "Shop".   [/p][/*][*][p]The number of wedge steel that can be refreshed at the wedge carver's has changed from 1 to 2, and the refresh time of the store has been shortened.  [/p][/*][*][p]In the residence's lounge, Blackboard and other stores, refreshable Wedge Steel has been added.   [/p][/*][*][p]A considerable number of one-way doors have been adjusted or removed.  [/p][/*][*][p]Adjust a few terrain details to facilitate more comfortable movement and exploration.  [/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Bug fixes:[/b]   [/p][list][*][p]Fix the issue of the position disorder of the Buff and Debuff Terminology Table button on non-16:9 screens.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fix the occasional scene switching anomaly issue that occurs when the frame rate is extremely low. [/p][/*][*][p]Fix the missing parts of the English translation and correct a few typos.   Fix the issue of incorrect trigger timing for some effects;  [/p][/*][*][p]Fix the issue where collectibles from the neighboring area cannot be picked up.   [/p][/*][*][p]Fix the issue where the Mǐn Store cannot be interacted with when the controller is in use.   [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the battle would freeze when fighting certain bosses.   [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Item Enhancement:[/b]   [/p][p]Enhancements to the Law - Colorful Dance (Insight), Crimson Slash(Skill), Non-Drowning (Skill)  [/p][p][/p][p][b]If there are any problems with the game, please refer to this announcement~! ↓↓↓[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2678640/view/515218419125059807"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][h3]
Subsequent schedule: 
[/h3][p][b]Infinite Boss Rush[/b]  [/p][list][*][p] In the endless battle, push Lulu's abilities to the limit and try to reach as far as possible in the waves.  [/p][/*][*][p] Infinite Battle Mode is a free update and will be given to all game owners soon!   [/p][/*][/list][p][b]More small accessories for the main characters:[/b]  [/p][list][*][p] More main character accessories are on the way!  [/p][/*][*][p] At the same time, some details of the protagonist will be slightly optimized later.  [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Steam Trading Cards and Points Store(Implemented on June 6th!):[/b]   [/p][list][*][p]Game-related collectible card and point store items are currently under review and will be available soon!              [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Regarding DLC:[/b]  [/p][p]Although there is a willingness to create game expansion content, reality also needs to be taken into account apart from the game; thus, the DLC is not yet confirmed. [/p][p]Hope to have the opportunity to make it!           [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b][i]Finally, welcome to join the group below ↓↓↓ and have a pleasant chat together![/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: The issue of too many one-way doors is being optimized~
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone~ːluvː[/p][h3]Since its release, we have received many valuable suggestions, one of which is the issue of too many one-way doors in the scene;[/h3][p]Therefore, one-way doors will continue to be optimized in subsequent updates to minimize the negative experience that may arise from having too many one-way doors~[/p][p]Two optimization methods:[/p][list][*][p]Remove useless one-way doors (as the game map design has been finalized, there may be few one-way doors that can be removed, but we will try our best to do so)[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize the position of the one-way door to prevent running a long distance to the door and finding that it cannot be opened; (Focus on optimization points)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]At the same time, one-way doors also have small identification skills, which can only be opened on the side where the door lock protrudes;[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780535/fc1e8f934de89606769d22dbaefe6930986b1944.png"][/img][/p][p]Once you know this, you don't need to try every time you go to the door;[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Finally, I wish you a great experience on your journey to the realm![/p]

notes.title: Tips for troubleshooting and obtaining achievements
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, I'm the developer of Dawn Dew. Today, I'd like to share with you some achievements and troubleshooting tips. Thank you for your support!  ːluvː[/p][p][/p][h3]Lack of achievements with "Recalling the initial stance" [/h3][p]Create a new save file to earn this achievement. (The reason is that this is likely to be your first game achievement. When attempting to activate the achievement, the Steam link was unstable and timed out without activation.) [/p][p][/p][h3]All the props have been collected, but the achievement of "Collecting All Items" has not been obtained. [/h3][p]After you confirm that you have collected all the items, you can freely pick up or synthesize any item to unlock the achievement. [/p][p][/p][h3]I have achieved 74 achievements, but I haven't obtained the "Get all achievements" achievement. [/h3][p]After saving the game, close it and re-enter. Then the last achievement will be unlocked. [/p][p][/p][h3]Tips：[/h3][p]Under normal circumstances in the game, all achievements can be obtained in the first playthrough. [/p][p]If you are very eager to achieve all the achievements and collect all the items in the first playthrough, then before fighting each "Fools", please interact fully with all the NPCs and complete the side quests. The battles against the Fools are the dividing line for whether many related items in the game can be obtained.[/p]

notes.title: The Insight of assisting 100% exploration has been implemented!
notes.content: [p]Hi ![/p][p]I've read many suggestions and after fixing the tricky bugs, I finally managed to arrange the full collection assistant that many of you mentioned a lot today! [/p][p]****How to Obtain**** [/p][p]Purchasing Experience from "Mechan": Heart of Exploration [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780535/5ddc1df4046635ed2bb6f1025fabdf6033e90c90.png"][/img][/p][p]At the same time, we also report on some updates and fixes: [/p][list][*][p]Fall damage no longer causes death. [/p][/*][*][p]Add white arrow main route guidance to the map of the last scene. [/p][/*][*][p]We have adjusted a few wind fields in the Ruins of King Li. They are no longer one-way up and not allowing descent. We have also added signposts for the Xi Tree Road in King Li's City. We will continue to make adjustments to other areas as the situation requires. [/p][/*][*][p]In the land where compassion endures and the garden where truth is sought, a great many crimson butterfly dances (red flowers) have been added, making them much easier to gather; they mostly grow along the edges of small plots.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes / Game Troubleshooting Guide.
notes.content: [h3]Hello everyone![/h3][p]ːluvːThe first day of Chao Lu's release has come to an end. Thank you all for your support! ːluvː[/p][p]You may have noticed that on the first day of release, the game has been updated 5 to 6 times. Now, I'll give you a brief report on the updates. [/p][list][*][p][b]Attempted to fix the occasional issue where players are unable to pass through platforms.[/b] (If you still encounter this problem, please save the game first, then return to the title screen and reload the save file. This should resolve the issue. We are still closely monitoring and working on this bug!) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed the issue where the store could bypass quantity limits under certain circumstances. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fix several errors and omissions in the map drawing. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Optimize some plot areas in certain scenarios; [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Optimize some language expressions and fix one omission in the English translation.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h2]-Important- Game Troubleshooting[/h2][hr][/hr][p][b]Occasional Disarray of Controller Button Positions:[/b] [/p][p]The in-game controller key map is currently only compatible with Xbox controllers. We are very sorry. [/p][p]If the actual functions of the buttons on the controller are disordered, it is very likely caused by the default controller settings of Steam. Please disable Steam input or modify the default controller settings of Steam. [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]There is a continuous upward/downward input from the controller, but I didn't press it[/b]：[/p][p]Check the "Disable controller" option in the game's settings interface/graphics settings;[/p][p](This bug is extremely occasional and is related to computer hardware and engine input. If this bug occurs, it can currently only be played using keyboard and mouse.)[/p][p]You can also disable Steam input and disconnect the controller (and delete the connection record between the controller and the computer) to try;[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Regarding Archiving:[/b] [/p][p]When saving the game, it requires very little hard disk space. However, you still need to ensure that the C drive has this remaining capacity; otherwise, you may not be able to save the game or encounter save errors. [/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Regarding the sudden exit:[/b] [/p][p]The issue of sudden crashes is very rare. Currently, most of the reported sudden crashes occur on RTX 4060 devices. [/p][p][b]Solution:[/b] [/p][p]1.Disable Steam Input; (Right-click on the game/content/controller in the library and select Disable Steam Input) [/p][p]2. If the issue persists after disabling Steam input, please check if your graphics card driver is a stable version. [/p][p]3. If there is an external gamepad (especially a Switch gamepad), please disconnect it from the computer and then start the game.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]SteamDeck Icon Display Issues/Graphical Glitches:[/b][/p][p align="start"]If you experience incorrect icon displays or screen artifacts while running the game on SteamDeck, please adjust your SteamDeck's compatibility layer to a more stable compatibility version to resolve the issue.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]When using SteamDeck/gamepad, interactive prompts display keyboard/mouse controls instead of gamepad-specific cues:[/b][/p][p align="start"]This issue arises from Steam's simulated keyboard/mouse mapping layout, commonly occurring on SteamDeck. To resolve: press the 'Steam Button' on your SteamDeck, open Controller Settings, and change the current controller layout from keyboard/mouse to gamepad mode.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Finally, I wish you a wonderful experience on your journey of exploration!ːluvː[/p][p]best regards, [/p][p]Scallion Rabbit on August 15, 2025[/p]

notes.title: "Journey of Realm: Dawn Dew" Releases Today!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]After a long period of development, "Journey of Realm: Dawn Dew"is officially released today![/p][p]The art, programming, and design of the game were all crafted by me alone. This is also my very first game.[/p][previewyoutube="zPowwMf5Rsg;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3][b]🔮In the game, you will experience:[/b][/h3][p]· The Adorable Fluffy White-Haired Protagonist "Dew"[/p][p]No one knows why Dew descended into this realm, but through your journey, you will uncover the truth.[/p][p] [/p][p]· A Handcrafted Game World[/p][p]The game contains NO AI-Generated Content. All environmental art and the vast majority of other artwork were personally drawn by me.[/p][p] [/p][p]· Extensively Varied Combat Mechanics[/p][p]Awaken your memories and freely transform your form in battle. Nearly every combat element can be freely combined to create your unique fighting style.[/p][p] [/p][p]· Exploration-Rich Environments[/p][p]Freely explore diverse, uniquely styled scenes while collecting items and tools. Don’t worry—tools are not consumables, so use them freely! As you explore, the history of the realm will gradually unfold…[/p][p] [/p][p]· Turn-Based, but with Real-Time Parry[/p][p]Experience parrying within a classic turn-based system. With enough skill, this will be your ultimate tool to overcome stronger foes.[/p][p]Prefer pure turn-based? No problem! Parrying is purely optional—even if you never use it, your experience remains unaffected. The core design remains turn-based combat.[/p][p] [/p][p]· More Stories Await Your Discovery[/p][p]The land lies cracked and barren, but you will nourish and mend it. Embark on a journey in pursuit of goodness, and bring answers to the grandest, most unrealistic, most romantic gamble of all.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]💐A big thank you to everyone who supported Dawn Dew to this day![/b][/h3][p]I hope to bring you more polished hits in the future—fingers crossed![/p][p][/p][p]As a solo-developed game, minor oversights may occur. If you encounter any bugs, feel free to:[/p][p][/p][p]Join our Discord channel to report, OR submit directly via the form below. Suggestions and feedback are also welcome through this form![/p][p]Feedback Form: [/p][p][url="https://wj.qq.com/s2/23456469/d042/"]https://wj.qq.com/s2/23456469/d042/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]If there are any problems with the game, please refer to this announcement~! ↓↓↓[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2678640/view/515218419125059807"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p]Finally, thank you for playing, and thank you for embarking on this journey through the realm.[/p][p][/p][p]— Scallion Rabbit[/p][p]August 14, 2025[/p]

notes.title: The New Product Festival is approaching! Demo update!
Since November 2024, the Demo (trial version) has been updated 21 times.
「Demo」V1.055 Further updates
Demo Update to：V1.055
Demo Update to：V1.035
notes.content:
To bring you a good experience is an important goal of "JOR: Dawn Dew". To this end, the free trial version has undergone [b] major updates [/b]. At the same time, the content of the official version is also in progress - your attention is the biggest encouragement for "JOR: Dawn Dew" ~

[i] Here are the main updates: [/i]
[list]
[*] [b]-- Content Update --[/b]
[*] New scene "Sea Gap" : unique challenges and tasks here.
[*] Item system major revision: Items are no longer consumables, you can use them as much as you like!
[*] Added difficulty options: 3 difficulty levels to choose from.
[*] New mission system: When you feel lost in your goal, the mission can help you anchor your direction. But it will never bother you when you want to explore freely.
[*] New equipment preset function: save your carefully built combat mode, more convenient to experience different combat schools.
[*] Added "Beast Tide Source Point" : a new challenge point in the scene, where you can meet multiple enemy challenges.
[*] Optimize character movements and expressions, optimize skill performance;
[*] Added unique text animation for killing bosses
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]-- Game changes --[/b]
[*] Attitude changed from 5 to 4
[*] The maximum number of heart points carried was changed from 8 to 10, and the initial capacity was changed to 6 points
[*] Modify the game's opening words
[*] Unclassify material items and change them all to items
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]-- Correlation optimization --[/b]
[*] Player locations are always visible on the map, and NPC locations are displayed on the map
[*] Redraw all pose ICONS
[*] Optimize battle scene layout
[*] Optimized some monster skeleton animations
[*] Optimize map design and adjust resource distribution
[*] Optimize UI interface performance;
[/list]
[b]Tips:[/b]
[b] As the game is in the development stage, the system has been greatly changed, so the new version Demo does not support the old version Demo archive, I would like to express my sincere apologies to you. [/b]

Finally, as a personal development of the game, your suggestions are very important to me, [b] you can join the QQ group: 932066312[/b], and directly communicate with me.

notes.title: The free trial version has been Updated
